content.title: British Mother's Day Mystery - Why It's NOT in May?
content.text: Did you know that Mother’s Day in the UK is celebrated in March—not May like in many other countries? In this video, you'll discover the surprising reason why UK Mother’s Day (also called Mothering Sunday) falls on a different date each year. 🌷 We’ll explore the history, traditions, and meaningful British vocabulary around this special day, including phrases like “put your feet up”, “take a load off”, and “quality time.” Plus, I’ll share a sweet personal story from my childhood about how I used to celebrate my mum!
